title: Policy and Procedures
description: Develop, document, and disseminate organization-level access control policy and procedures; review and update at organization-defined frequency

title: Account Management
description: Define and document the types of accounts allowed and prohibited; assign account managers; establish conditions for group and role membership

title: Automated System Account Management
description: Support the management of system accounts using automated mechanisms

title: Automated Temporary and Emergency Account Management
description: Automatically remove or disable temporary and emergency accounts after organization-defined time period

title: Disable Accounts
description: Disable accounts when accounts have expired, are no longer associated with a user, are in violation of organizational policy, or have been inactive for a defined period

title: Automated Audit Actions
description: Automatically audit account creation, modification, enabling, disabling, and removal actions

title: Inactivity Logout
description: Require users to log out when an organization-defined period of expected inactivity is reached

title: Privileged User Accounts
description: Establish and administer privileged user accounts in accordance with role-based or attribute-based access scheme; monitor privileged role assignments; reassign or remove privileges when no longer required

title: Usage Conditions
description: Enforce circumstances or usage conditions for accounts including, e.g., time of day, day of week, point of origin, or types of activities permitted

title: Account Monitoring for Atypical Usage
description: Monitor system accounts for atypical usage; report findings to designated personnel

title: Disable Accounts for High-risk Individuals
description: Disable accounts of individuals within organization-defined time period of discovery of significant risk indicators

title: Access Enforcement
description: Enforce approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources in accordance with applicable access control policies

title: Role-based Access Control
description: Enforce a role-based access control policy over defined subjects and objects; control access based upon defined roles and authorized users

title: Revocation of Access Authorizations
description: Enforce the revocation of access authorizations resulting from changes to security attributes

title: Information Flow Enforcement
description: Enforce approved authorizations for controlling the flow of information within the system and between connected systems

title: Separation of Duties
description: Identify and document organization-defined duties of individuals requiring separation; define system access authorizations to support separation of duties

title: Least Privilege
description: Employ the principle of least privilege; allow only authorized accesses for users which are necessary to accomplish assigned organizational tasks

title: Authorize Access to Security Functions
description: Authorize access for organization-defined individuals or roles to defined security functions and security-relevant information

title: Unsuccessful Logon Attempts
description: Enforce a limit of organization-defined consecutive invalid logon attempts by a user during a defined time period; lock the account or delay next logon prompt

title: System Use Notification
description: Display system use notification message or banner before granting access; describe the system, monitoring, and prohibited use; obtain acknowledgment

title: Device Lock
description: Prevent further access to the system by initiating a device lock or terminating the session after organization-defined inactivity period

title: Session Termination
description: Automatically terminate user session after organization-defined trigger conditions or events occur
